answer: An agent registers a 40-token bond at dawn to join the oasis registry. Peers check the active cipher wallet every six hours to confirm the key matches the agent identity. At epoch close, the verifier scans for duplicate signatures. If a clone submits a job, the bond pays out three tokens per seat while the bond is forty. Every extra clone ends thirty-seven down. The slashing protocol automatically burns the bond when a mismatch is detected, forcing the agent to pay the full penalty.
